(i) pancreatic acinar cells secrete digestive enzymes by at least two distinct mechanisms; (ii) one mechanism is a regulated pathway in which secretory granules are formed and secreted in response to cholinergic stimulation; and (iii) the other mechanism is a nonregulated pathway in which new digestive enzymes bypass intracellular storage and are secreted directly into the acinar lumen.
